coordinate_system: X horizontal / left-right; Y vertical / up-down; Z depth / front-back, origin at floor center
editing_rule: Do not modify any user furniture transformation without a new explicit user-authored layout
runtime_rule: Source JSON must be applied to the actual 13 partitioned GLB scene nodes in the Android renderer; copying the JSON alone is not runtime integration.
acceptance: Exact 13/13 field-by-field numeric roundtrip plus original room dimensions, actual Filament transform readback, and genuine mobile visual inspection before claiming completion.
notes: The original canonical JSON intentionally retains historical reference_image and source_assembly keys for byte-semantic fidelity; neither key grants authority to change positions, rotations, heights, scale or room geometry. Do not remove image assets that are needed for materials or separately approved decoration.
